items.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: recorded with fellow guitarists Joe Pass, Barney Kessel and Charlie Byrd

ctx.x: Herb Ellis demonstrates the idea of “minimum effort, maximum results.” His melodic guitar playing has been an integral part of numerous classic jazz recordings, especially with the renown Oscar Peterson Trio of the 1950s. He was born in Texas in 1921, graduated from North Texas State, and found inspiration from Charlie Christian, another Texas guitarist. Previous to joining Oscar Peterson he played with Glen Grey, Jimmy Dorsey and the Soft Winds Trio. Herb often accompanied Ella Fitzgerald and recorded with…
Herb was interviewed by Michael Woods in Los Angeles on September 3, 1995.
